groups.title: Resizing
groups.description: Dragging a window's border with the mouse to resize it.

groups.title: Snapping
groups.description: Floating windows snap to nearby windows and monitor edges as you drag them.

groups.title: Blur
groups.description: Frosted glass behind see-through windows.

groups.title: Blurred surfaces
groups.description: What else gets blurred besides windows: popups, input methods and the special workspace.

groups.title: Glow
groups.description: A soft light just inside each window's edge.

groups.title: Scrolling
groups.description: Mice and touchpads each take their own direction and speed.

groups.title: Focus
groups.description: How the window under the mouse takes keyboard focus.

groups.title: Tablet area
groups.description: Which part of the screen the tablet maps to, and which part of the tablet responds.

groups.title: Virtual keyboards
groups.description: On-screen and remote keyboards that apps create.

groups.title: Swipe sensitivity
groups.description: How far and how fast a swipe has to go before Hyprland acts on it.

groups.title: Dragging
groups.description: What happens when you drag a window onto a group or its tab bar.

groups.title: Tab bar
groups.description: The row of window tabs drawn above a group, which Hyprland calls the group bar.

groups.title: Wallpaper and splash
groups.description: What Hyprland draws when no wallpaper app is running, and the font it uses for its own text.

groups.title: Swallowing
groups.description: A terminal hides while an app it launched is open, and comes back when the app closes.

groups.title: Overrides
groups.description: Exceptions to how keybinds normally treat groups, pinned windows and apps.

groups.title: X11 apps
groups.description: Older applications that run through XWayland instead of natively on Wayland.

groups.title: Colour pipeline
groups.description: Experimental internals: leave them alone unless a colour problem needs them.

groups.title: Warping
groups.description: Jumping the cursor to a window or monitor when focus moves.

groups.title: Fullscreen VRR
groups.description: How cursor movement behaves in fullscreen apps that use variable refresh rate.

groups.title: Single window
groups.description: How a window that is alone on its workspace is shaped.

groups.title: Centred master
groups.description: Used when the master area position is set to centre.

groups.title: Colour management
groups.description: A preview of newer colour-management protocol support.

general:border_size.title: Border size
general:border_size.help: Width of the border around every window, in pixels. Set it to 0 to remove borders.

general:gaps_in.title: Inner gaps
general:gaps_in.help: Space between neighbouring windows, in pixels. One number applies to every side; four give top, right, bottom and left.

general:gaps_out.title: Outer gaps
general:gaps_out.help: Space between windows and the screen edges, in pixels. One number applies to every side; four give top, right, bottom and left.

general:float_gaps.title: Floating window gaps
general:float_gaps.help: Space between floating windows and the screen edges, in pixels. Leave it unset to use the outer gaps.

general:gaps_workspaces.title: Workspace gaps
general:gaps_workspaces.help: Space between workspaces, in pixels. It adds to the outer gaps.

general:col.inactive_border.title: Inactive border colour
general:col.inactive_border.help: Border colour of windows without focus. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

general:col.active_border.title: Active border colour
general:col.active_border.help: Border colour of the window with focus. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

general:col.nogroup_border.title: Ungrouped border colour
general:col.nogroup_border.help: Border colour of a window without focus that cannot be added to a group.

general:col.nogroup_border_active.title: Active ungrouped border colour
general:col.nogroup_border_active.help: Border colour of the window with focus when it cannot be added to a group.

general:layout.title: Layout
general:layout.help: Which tiling layout to use. Custom Lua layouts are selectable as lua:<name>.

general:no_focus_fallback.title: Never refocus after closing a window
general:no_focus_fallback.help: Stops focus from jumping to another window when you move it in a direction that has no window.

general:resize_on_border.title: Resize windows by dragging their border
general:resize_on_border.help: Lets you resize a window by dragging its border, or the gaps around it, with the mouse.

general:extend_border_grab_area.title: Border grab area
general:extend_border_grab_area.help: How far outside a border, in pixels, you can still grab it to resize. Applies only when resizing by border is on.

general:hover_icon_on_border.title: Show the resize cursor on borders
general:hover_icon_on_border.help: Shows a resize cursor when the pointer is over a border. Applies only when resizing by border is on.

general:allow_tearing.title: Allow tearing
general:allow_tearing.help: Master switch for screen tearing, which lowers input lag in games. A window also needs the immediate window rule to tear.

general:resize_corner.title: Resize corner
general:resize_corner.help: Makes floating windows always resize from one corner, instead of the one nearest the pointer.

general:snap:enabled.title: Snap floating windows
general:snap:enabled.help: Makes a floating window you drag line up with nearby windows and screen edges.

general:snap:window_gap.title: Snap distance to windows
general:snap:window_gap.help: How close, in pixels, a dragged window must come to another window before it snaps to it.

general:snap:monitor_gap.title: Snap distance to monitor edges
general:snap:monitor_gap.help: How close, in pixels, a dragged window must come to a screen edge before it snaps to it.

general:snap:border_overlap.title: Overlap borders when snapping
general:snap:border_overlap.help: Lets snapped windows sit with only one border's width between them, so their borders overlap.

general:snap:respect_gaps.title: Respect gaps when snapping
general:snap:respect_gaps.help: Keeps the inner gap between snapped windows instead of letting them touch.

general:modal_parent_blocking.title: Block interaction with modal parents
general:modal_parent_blocking.help: Blocks clicks and typing in a window while one of its modal dialogs is open.

general:locale.title: Locale
general:locale.help: Overrides the system language Hyprland uses, such as en_US or es. Leave it empty to follow the system.

decoration:rounding.title: Corner rounding
decoration:rounding.help: Radius of rounded window corners, in pixels. Set it to 0 for square corners.

decoration:rounding_power.title: Rounding power
decoration:rounding_power.help: Shapes the rounded corners: 2 is a circle, 4 a squircle, and higher is squarer still. Ranges from 2 to 10.

decoration:active_opacity.title: Active window opacity
decoration:active_opacity.help: How opaque the window with focus is, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

decoration:inactive_opacity.title: Inactive window opacity
decoration:inactive_opacity.help: How opaque windows without focus are, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

decoration:fullscreen_opacity.title: Fullscreen window opacity
decoration:fullscreen_opacity.help: How opaque fullscreen windows are, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

decoration:shadow:enabled.title: Drop shadow
decoration:shadow:enabled.help: Draws a soft shadow behind every window.

decoration:shadow:range.title: Shadow size
decoration:shadow:range.help: How far a shadow reaches out from its window, in pixels.

decoration:shadow:render_power.title: Shadow falloff
decoration:shadow:render_power.help: How quickly a shadow fades out: higher is a faster, tighter falloff. Ranges from 1 to 4.

decoration:shadow:sharp.title: Sharp shadow
decoration:shadow:sharp.help: Gives shadows a hard edge instead of a soft fade.

decoration:shadow:color.title: Shadow colour
decoration:shadow:color.help: Colour of window shadows. Its alpha sets how dark the shadow is.

decoration:shadow:color_inactive.title: Inactive shadow colour
decoration:shadow:color_inactive.help: Shadow colour of windows without focus. When unset, the normal shadow colour is used.

decoration:shadow:offset.title: Shadow offset
decoration:shadow:offset.help: How far shadows shift from their window, as a horizontal and a vertical distance in pixels.

decoration:shadow:scale.title: Shadow scale
decoration:shadow:scale.help: Scales each shadow relative to its window, from 0 to 1.

decoration:glow:enabled.title: Inner glow
decoration:glow:enabled.help: Draws a coloured light just inside each window's edge.

decoration:glow:range.title: Glow size
decoration:glow:range.help: How far the glow reaches into the window, in pixels.

decoration:glow:render_power.title: Glow falloff
decoration:glow:render_power.help: How quickly the glow fades out: higher is a faster, tighter falloff. Ranges from 1 to 4.

decoration:glow:color.title: Glow colour
decoration:glow:color.help: Colour of the glow. Its alpha sets how strong the glow is.

decoration:glow:color_inactive.title: Inactive glow colour
decoration:glow:color_inactive.help: Glow colour of windows without focus. When unset, the normal glow colour is used.

decoration:dim_modal.title: Dim parents of modal windows
decoration:dim_modal.help: Dims the parent window while one of its modal dialogs is open.

decoration:dim_inactive.title: Dim inactive windows
decoration:dim_inactive.help: Dims windows that do not have focus, by the amount set in dim strength.

decoration:dim_strength.title: Dim strength
decoration:dim_strength.help: How strongly windows without focus are dimmed, from 0 (not at all) to 1 (fully dark).

decoration:dim_special.title: Special workspace dim
decoration:dim_special.help: How much the rest of the screen dims while a special workspace is open, from 0 to 1.

decoration:dim_around.title: Dim around dialogs
decoration:dim_around.help: How much a window with the dim around rule darkens the screen behind it, from 0 to 1.

decoration:screen_shader.title: Screen shader
decoration:screen_shader.help: Path to a GLSL shader file applied to the whole screen after everything else is drawn. Leave it empty for none.

decoration:border_part_of_window.title: Border counts as part of the window

decoration:blur:enabled.title: Blur
decoration:blur:enabled.help: Blurs whatever shows through see-through windows. It costs some graphics performance.

decoration:blur:size.title: Blur size
decoration:blur:size.help: How far the blur spreads, in pixels. Larger values look softer and cost more.

decoration:blur:passes.title: Blur passes
decoration:blur:passes.help: How many times the blur is applied. More passes look smoother but cost more performance.

decoration:blur:ignore_opacity.title: Ignore window opacity when blurring
decoration:blur:ignore_opacity.help: Keeps the blur at full strength behind a see-through window, instead of fading it with the window's opacity.

decoration:blur:new_optimizations.title: Blur optimisations
decoration:blur:new_optimizations.help: Speeds blur up considerably. Leave it on unless you have a reason not to.

decoration:blur:xray.title: X-ray blur
decoration:blur:xray.help: Makes floating windows blur only the wallpaper behind them, not the tiled windows. Needs blur optimisations, and is cheaper.

decoration:blur:noise.title: Blur noise
decoration:blur:noise.help: How much film grain is added to the blur, from 0 to 1.

decoration:blur:contrast.title: Blur contrast
decoration:blur:contrast.help: Adjusts the contrast of the blurred area, from 0 to 2.

decoration:blur:brightness.title: Blur brightness
decoration:blur:brightness.help: Adjusts the brightness of the blurred area, from 0 to 2.

decoration:blur:vibrancy.title: Blur vibrancy
decoration:blur:vibrancy.help: Boosts the colour saturation of the blur, from 0 to 1.

decoration:blur:vibrancy_darkness.title: Blur vibrancy on dark colours
decoration:blur:vibrancy_darkness.help: How strongly the saturation boost applies to dark areas, from 0 to 1.

decoration:blur:special.title: Blur the special workspace
decoration:blur:special.help: Blurs what is behind the special workspace. This costs extra performance.

decoration:blur:popups.title: Blur popups
decoration:blur:popups.help: Blurs popups such as right-click menus.

decoration:blur:popups_ignorealpha.title: Popup blur alpha threshold
decoration:blur:popups_ignorealpha.help: Popup pixels more see-through than this are not blurred. Ranges from 0 to 1.

decoration:blur:input_methods.title: Blur input methods
decoration:blur:input_methods.help: Blurs the surfaces of input methods such as fcitx5.

decoration:blur:input_methods_ignorealph.title: Input method blur alpha threshold
decoration:blur:input_methods_ignorealph.help: Input method pixels more see-through than this are not blurred. Ranges from 0 to 1.

decoration:motion_blur:enabled.title: Motion blur
decoration:motion_blur:enabled.help: Blurs windows while they move or change dimensions.

decoration:motion_blur:samples.title: Motion blur samples
decoration:motion_blur:samples.help: How many samples build the motion blur. More give a clearer blur but cost more performance.

animations:enabled.title: Animations
animations:enabled.help: Turns every window and workspace animation on or off.

animations:workspace_wraparound.title: Wrap workspace animations
animations:workspace_wraparound.help: Slides between the first and last workspace as if they were neighbours.

input:kb_model.title: Keyboard model
input:kb_model.help: The XKB keyboard model, such as pc105. Leave it empty unless your keyboard needs a specific one.

input:kb_layout.title: Keyboard layout
input:kb_layout.help: Your keyboard layout as an XKB code, such as us or de. Separate several layouts with commas to switch between them.

input:kb_variant.title: Keyboard variant
input:kb_variant.help: A variant of your layout, such as dvorak. With several layouts, give one variant for each, separated by commas.

input:kb_options.title: Keyboard options
input:kb_options.help: Extra XKB options, such as caps:escape or grp:alt_shift_toggle. Separate several with commas.

input:kb_rules.title: Keyboard rules
input:kb_rules.help: Which XKB rules file builds the keymap. Leave it empty to use the system's default.

input:kb_file.title: Keymap file
input:kb_file.help: Path to your own .xkb keymap file. When set, it overrides the other keyboard layout settings.

input:numlock_by_default.title: Enable Num Lock at startup
input:numlock_by_default.help: Turns Num Lock on when Hyprland starts.

input:resolve_binds_by_sym.title: Match keybinds by symbol
input:resolve_binds_by_sym.help: With several layouts, matches a keybind against the symbol you type, not the key's place in the first layout.

input:repeat_rate.title: Key repeat rate
input:repeat_rate.help: How many times per second a held key repeats.

input:repeat_delay.title: Key repeat delay
input:repeat_delay.help: How long you hold a key, in milliseconds, before it starts repeating.

input:sensitivity.title: Pointer sensitivity
input:sensitivity.help: Mouse speed, from -1 (slowest) to 1 (fastest). 0 leaves the device's default speed.

input:accel_profile.title: Pointer acceleration
input:accel_profile.help: How the pointer speeds up as you move the mouse faster. Unset keeps the device's own mode.

input:force_no_accel.title: Disable pointer acceleration
input:force_no_accel.help: Removes pointer acceleration and most pointer adjustments for a raw signal. Not recommended: the cursor can fall out of sync.

input:rotation.title: Pointer rotation
input:rotation.help: Rotates a device's input by this many degrees clockwise, from 0 to 359.

input:left_handed.title: Swap left and right buttons
input:left_handed.help: Swaps the left and right mouse buttons.

input:scroll_points.title: Custom acceleration points
input:scroll_points.help: Custom scroll acceleration curve, written as a step and then the points. Used only when the pointer acceleration profile is custom.

input:scroll_method.title: Scroll method
input:scroll_method.help: How a device produces scrolling, such as with two fingers or by holding a button. Unset keeps the device's default.

input:scroll_button.title: Scroll button
input:scroll_button.help: Which mouse button scrolls while held, as a button code; 0 keeps the device's default. Find a code with the wev tool.

input:scroll_button_lock.title: Scroll button lock
input:scroll_button_lock.help: Lets you press the scroll button once to start scrolling and again to stop, instead of holding it.

input:scroll_factor.title: Mouse scroll speed
input:scroll_factor.help: Multiplier for scrolling with an external mouse; 1 is the normal speed. Touchpads have their own setting.

input:natural_scroll.title: Mouse natural scrolling
input:natural_scroll.help: Reverses the mouse scroll direction, so scrolling moves the content directly instead of the scrollbar.

input:follow_mouse.title: Focus follows mouse
input:follow_mouse.help: Whether moving the pointer changes which window has focus, and how. When off, you click a window to focus it.

input:follow_mouse_threshold.title: Focus follows mouse threshold
input:follow_mouse_threshold.help: How far the pointer must travel, in pixels, before focus follows it. Applies only when focus simply follows the mouse.

input:focus_on_close.title: Focus after closing a window
input:focus_on_close.help: Decides which window takes focus when the focused one closes.

input:mouse_refocus.title: Refocus when the mouse moves
input:mouse_refocus.help: When off, hovering a window does not move focus unless the pointer crosses into it from another window. Applies when focus follows the mouse.

input:float_switch_override_focus.title: Refocus on float/tile switch
input:float_switch_override_focus.help: Moves focus to the window under the pointer when a window switches between tiled and floating. 2 also does so between two floating windows.

input:special_fallthrough.title: Special workspace fallthrough
input:special_fallthrough.help: Lets you focus windows on the regular workspace when the special workspace holds only floating windows.

input:off_window_axis_events.title: Scroll events outside windows
input:off_window_axis_events.help: How scrolling is handled when the pointer is just outside the focused window, in its gaps or at its edges.

input:emulate_discrete_scroll.title: Emulate discrete scrolling
input:emulate_discrete_scroll.help: Turns smooth, high-resolution scrolling into notched wheel steps, for apps that expect them.

input:follow_mouse_shrink.title: Shrink focus hitboxes by
input:follow_mouse_shrink.help: Shrinks the area of inactive windows that counts for focus by this many pixels, leaving a dead zone in the gaps. Applies when focus follows the mouse.

input:touchpad:disable_while_typing.title: Disable while typing
input:touchpad:disable_while_typing.help: Turns the touchpad off while you type, so a resting palm does not move the cursor.

input:touchpad:natural_scroll.title: Touchpad natural scrolling
input:touchpad:natural_scroll.help: Reverses the touchpad scroll direction, so scrolling moves the content directly instead of the scrollbar.

input:touchpad:scroll_factor.title: Touchpad scroll speed
input:touchpad:scroll_factor.help: Multiplier for touchpad scrolling; 1 is the normal speed. Mice have their own setting.

input:touchpad:middle_button_emulation.title: Middle button emulation
input:touchpad:middle_button_emulation.help: Pressing the left and right buttons together counts as a middle click. This turns off any touchpad area that sends a middle click.

input:touchpad:tap_button_map.title: Tap button mapping
input:touchpad:tap_button_map.help: Which mouse buttons a tap with one, two and three fingers sends.

input:touchpad:clickfinger_behavior.title: Clickfinger behaviour
input:touchpad:clickfinger_behavior.help: Clicking with 1, 2 or 3 fingers sends a left, right or middle click, instead of depending on where you press.

input:touchpad:tap-to-click.title: Tap to click
input:touchpad:tap-to-click.help: Tapping with 1, 2 or 3 fingers sends a left, right or middle click.

input:touchpad:drag_lock.title: Drag lock
input:touchpad:drag_lock.help: Lifting your finger during a drag does not drop the item. 0 is off, 1 drops it after a timeout, 2 holds it until you tap.

input:touchpad:tap-and-drag.title: Tap and drag
input:touchpad:tap-and-drag.help: Lets you tap, then touch again and drag, to move things with one finger.

input:touchpad:flip_x.title: Flip the horizontal axis
input:touchpad:flip_x.help: Reverses left and right movement on the touchpad.

input:touchpad:flip_y.title: Flip the vertical axis
input:touchpad:flip_y.help: Reverses up and down movement on the touchpad.

input:touchpad:drag_3fg.title: Three-finger drag
input:touchpad:drag_3fg.help: Lets you drag with three or four fingers, as you choose. Off by default.

input:touchdevice:transform.title: Rotation
input:touchdevice:transform.help: Rotates touch screen input to match a turned monitor. 0 is normal; 1, 2 and 3 rotate by 90, 180 and 270 degrees.

input:touchdevice:output.title: Bound monitor
input:touchdevice:output.help: Which monitor touch screens map to, by name. By default Hyprland works it out itself.

input:virtualkeyboard:share_states.title: Share virtual keyboard states
input:virtualkeyboard:share_states.help: Whether virtual keyboards share held keys and modifiers with your real keyboards. 2 shares unless the virtual keyboard is an input method.

input:virtualkeyboard:release_pressed_on.title: Release pressed keys on close
input:virtualkeyboard:release_pressed_on.help: Releases every key a virtual keyboard still holds down when it closes.

input:tablet:transform.title: Rotation
input:tablet:transform.help: Rotates tablet input. 0 is normal; 1, 2 and 3 rotate by 90, 180 and 270 degrees.

input:tablet:output.title: Bound monitor
input:tablet:output.help: Which monitor the tablet maps to: a monitor name, or current. Leave it empty to span all monitors.

input:tablet:region_position.title: Region position
input:tablet:region_position.help: Where the mapped screen region starts, as horizontal and vertical distances from the top left of the bound monitor.

input:tablet:absolute_region_position.title: Absolute region position
input:tablet:absolute_region_position.help: Treats the region position as a spot in the layout of all monitors. Applies only when no monitor is bound.

input:tablet:region_size.title: Region size
input:tablet:region_size.help: Size of the screen region the tablet maps to. 0 by 0 leaves it unset.

input:tablet:relative_input.title: Relative input
input:tablet:relative_input.help: Makes the tablet move the pointer like a mouse, relative to where it is, instead of by absolute position.

input:tablet:left_handed.title: Left-handed
input:tablet:left_handed.help: Rotates the tablet by 180 degrees, for left-handed use.

input:tablet:active_area_size.title: Active area size
input:tablet:active_area_size.help: Size of the part of the tablet that responds, in millimetres.

input:tablet:active_area_position.title: Active area position
input:tablet:active_area_position.help: Where the responding part of the tablet starts, in millimetres.

input:tablettool:eraser_button_mode.title: Eraser button
input:tablettool:eraser_button_mode.help: Whether the pen's eraser button keeps its hardware behaviour (0) or sends a button press instead (1).

input:tablettool:eraser_button_override.title: Eraser button code
input:tablettool:eraser_button_override.help: Which button the eraser sends when it sends a button press, as a button code; 0 uses the default. Find a code with the wev tool.

input:tablettool:pressure_range_min.title: Minimum pressure
input:tablettool:pressure_range_min.help: Lowest pressure the pen reports. A negative value keeps the pen's own minimum, usually 0.

input:tablettool:pressure_range_max.title: Maximum pressure
input:tablettool:pressure_range_max.help: Highest pressure the pen reports. A negative value keeps the pen's own maximum, usually 1.

gestures:workspace_swipe_distance.title: Swipe distance
gestures:workspace_swipe_distance.help: How far you drag on the touchpad, in pixels, to swipe one workspace.

gestures:workspace_swipe_touch.title: Swipe on touchscreens
gestures:workspace_swipe_touch.help: Lets you swipe between workspaces from the edge of a touchscreen.

gestures:workspace_swipe_invert.title: Invert swipe direction
gestures:workspace_swipe_invert.help: Reverses the direction of workspace swipes on the touchpad.

gestures:workspace_swipe_touch_invert.title: Invert touchscreen swipe direction
gestures:workspace_swipe_touch_invert.help: Reverses the direction of workspace swipes on a touchscreen.

gestures:workspace_swipe_min_speed_to_fo.title: Minimum speed to force a switch
gestures:workspace_swipe_min_speed_to_fo.help: A swipe faster than this switches workspace even if it was short, ignoring the cancel ratio. 0 turns this off.

gestures:workspace_swipe_cancel_ratio.title: Cancel ratio
gestures:workspace_swipe_cancel_ratio.help: How much of the swipe distance you must cover to switch workspace. At 0.7, less than 70 percent snaps back.

gestures:workspace_swipe_create_new.title: Create a workspace by swiping past the end
gestures:workspace_swipe_create_new.help: Swiping right on the last workspace creates a new one.

gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock.title: Direction lock
gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock.help: Once a swipe passes the lock threshold, it can no longer change direction. Touchpad only.

gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock_.title: Direction lock threshold
gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock_.help: How far a swipe must travel, in pixels, before its direction locks. Touchpad only.

gestures:workspace_swipe_forever.title: Keep swiping past the last workspace
gestures:workspace_swipe_forever.help: Lets a swipe carry past the neighbouring workspace to ones further away, instead of stopping at it.

gestures:close_max_timeout.title: Close gesture timeout
gestures:close_max_timeout.help: How long, in milliseconds, a window has to close after a close gesture before it springs back.

gestures:scrolling:move_snap_to_grid.title: Snap to the grid when moving
gestures:scrolling:move_snap_to_grid.help: Snaps the window to the grid when you release a move gesture in the scrolling layout.

gestures:scrolling:move_snap_cursor.title: Snap to the cursor when moving
gestures:scrolling:move_snap_cursor.help: Moves the cursor onto the newly focused window when you release a move gesture in the scrolling layout.

group:insert_after_current.title: Insert after the current window
group:insert_after_current.help: Opens a new window in a group right after the current tab instead of at the end.

group:focus_removed_window.title: Focus a window removed from a group
group:focus_removed_window.help: Focuses a window right after you move it out of its group.

group:merge_groups_on_drag.title: Merge groups on drag
group:merge_groups_on_drag.help: Lets you drag one group into another to merge them.

group:merge_groups_on_groupbar.title: Merge groups dropped on a group bar
group:merge_groups_on_groupbar.help: Merges a group dropped on another group's bar. Works only when windows can be dragged into groups by the bar and groups merge on drag.

group:col.border_active.title: Active group border colour
group:col.border_active.help: Border colour of the group with focus. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

group:col.border_inactive.title: Inactive group border colour
group:col.border_inactive.help: Border colour of groups without focus. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

group:col.border_locked_inactive.title: Locked inactive group border colour
group:col.border_locked_inactive.help: Border colour of a locked group without focus.

group:col.border_locked_active.title: Locked active group border colour
group:col.border_locked_active.help: Border colour of a locked group with focus.

group:auto_group.title: Group new windows automatically
group:auto_group.help: Puts each new window into the focused group automatically, unless that group is locked.

group:drag_into_group.title: Drag windows into groups
group:drag_into_group.help: Whether dragging a window onto an unlocked group adds it to that group, and where you must drop it.

group:merge_floated_into_tiled_on_groupb.title: Merge floating windows into tiled groups
group:merge_floated_into_tiled_on_groupb.help: Lets you drop a floating window on a tiled window's group bar to merge them.

group:group_on_movetoworkspace.title: Group when moving to a workspace
group:group_on_movetoworkspace.help: Moving a window to a workspace that holds one unlocked group adds it to that group.

group:groupbar:enabled.title: Group bar
group:groupbar:enabled.help: Shows a bar with one tab per window on every group.

group:groupbar:disable_when_only.title: Hide when the group has one window
group:groupbar:disable_when_only.help: Hides the group bar when its group holds only one window.

group:groupbar:font_family.title: Font
group:groupbar:font_family.help: Font for the titles in the group bar. Leave it empty to use the general font.

group:groupbar:font_weight_active.title: Active title weight
group:groupbar:font_weight_active.help: How heavy the font of the active window's title is in the group bar. Pick a name, or type a number from 100 to 1000.

group:groupbar:font_weight_inactive.title: Inactive title weight
group:groupbar:font_weight_inactive.help: How heavy the font of the other windows' titles is in the group bar. Pick a name, or type a number from 100 to 1000.

group:groupbar:font_size.title: Font size
group:groupbar:font_size.help: Size of the title text in the group bar, in pixels.

group:groupbar:gradients.title: Gradient backgrounds
group:groupbar:gradients.help: Paints a gradient background behind each tab in the group bar.

group:groupbar:height.title: Height
group:groupbar:height.help: Height of the group bar, in pixels.

group:groupbar:indicator_gap.title: Indicator gap
group:groupbar:indicator_gap.help: Space between the group bar's indicator and the titles, in pixels.

group:groupbar:indicator_height.title: Indicator height
group:groupbar:indicator_height.help: Height of the group bar's indicator, in pixels.

group:groupbar:stacked.title: Stack titles vertically
group:groupbar:stacked.help: Lists a group's tabs one above the other instead of side by side.

group:groupbar:render_titles.title: Show window titles
group:groupbar:render_titles.help: Shows each window's title on its tab.

group:groupbar:scrolling.title: Scroll to switch windows
group:groupbar:scrolling.help: Scrolling over the group bar switches to the next or previous window in the group.

group:groupbar:middle_click_close.title: Middle-click to close
group:groupbar:middle_click_close.help: Middle-clicking a tab closes that window.

group:groupbar:rounding.title: Corner rounding
group:groupbar:rounding.help: Rounds the corners of the group bar's indicator, in pixels.

group:groupbar:rounding_power.title: Rounding power
group:groupbar:rounding_power.help: Shapes the rounded corners of the group bar: 2 is a circle, 4 a squircle. Ranges from 2 to 10.

group:groupbar:gradient_rounding.title: Gradient corner rounding
group:groupbar:gradient_rounding.help: Rounds the corners of the gradient backgrounds, in pixels.

group:groupbar:gradient_rounding_power.title: Gradient rounding power
group:groupbar:gradient_rounding_power.help: Shapes the rounded corners of the gradient backgrounds: 2 is a circle, 4 a squircle. Ranges from 2 to 10.

group:groupbar:round_only_edges.title: Round only the outer edges
group:groupbar:round_only_edges.help: Rounds only the outer ends of the indicator across the whole bar, not every tab's corners.

group:groupbar:gradient_round_only_edges.title: Round only the outer gradient edges
group:groupbar:gradient_round_only_edges.help: Rounds only the outer ends of the gradients across the whole bar, not every tab's corners.

group:groupbar:text_color.title: Title colour
group:groupbar:text_color.help: Colour of the window titles in the group bar.

group:groupbar:text_color_inactive.title: Inactive title colour
group:groupbar:text_color_inactive.help: Title colour of windows without focus in the group bar. Unset uses the title colour.

group:groupbar:text_color_locked_active.title: Locked active title colour
group:groupbar:text_color_locked_active.help: Title colour of the active window in a locked group. Unset uses the title colour.

group:groupbar:text_color_locked_inactiv.title: Locked inactive title colour
group:groupbar:text_color_locked_inactiv.null_label: Same as the inactive title colour
group:groupbar:text_color_locked_inactiv.help: Title colour of the other windows in a locked group. Unset uses the inactive title colour.

group:groupbar:col.active.title: Active background
group:groupbar:col.active.help: Background of the active tab in the group bar. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

group:groupbar:col.inactive.title: Inactive background
group:groupbar:col.inactive.help: Background of tabs without focus in the group bar. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

group:groupbar:col.locked_active.title: Locked active background
group:groupbar:col.locked_active.help: Background of the active tab of a locked group. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

group:groupbar:col.locked_inactive.title: Locked inactive background
group:groupbar:col.locked_inactive.help: Background of the other tabs of a locked group. Use one colour, or several with an angle for a gradient.

group:groupbar:gaps_out.title: Outer gaps
group:groupbar:gaps_out.help: Space between the gradient backgrounds and the window, in pixels.

group:groupbar:gaps_in.title: Inner gaps
group:groupbar:gaps_in.help: Space between neighbouring gradient backgrounds, in pixels.

group:groupbar:keep_upper_gap.title: Keep the upper gap
group:groupbar:keep_upper_gap.help: Keeps the gap above the gradient backgrounds. Turn it off to remove that gap.

group:groupbar:text_offset.title: Text offset
group:groupbar:text_offset.help: Moves the titles up or down in the group bar, in pixels.

group:groupbar:text_padding.title: Text padding
group:groupbar:text_padding.help: Space on each side of a title in the group bar, in pixels.

group:groupbar:blur.title: Blur the background
group:groupbar:blur.help: Blurs the group bar's indicators and gradient backgrounds.

misc:disable_hyprland_logo.title: Hide the Hyprland logo
misc:disable_hyprland_logo.help: Hides the random Hyprland logo or anime picture drawn on the desktop background.

misc:disable_splash_rendering.title: Hide the splash text
misc:disable_splash_rendering.help: Hides the splash text drawn on the Hyprland background.

misc:font_family.title: Font
misc:font_family.help: The font Hyprland uses for its own text, such as the FPS counter, notifications and error messages.

misc:splash_font_family.title: Splash font
misc:splash_font_family.help: The font used for the splash text. Choose one installed on this system.

misc:force_default_wallpaper.title: Default wallpaper
misc:force_default_wallpaper.help: Forces one of Hyprland's three built-in wallpapers. -1 picks one at random; 0 or 1 hide the anime picture.

misc:vrr.title: Variable refresh rate
misc:vrr.help: Lets monitors change their refresh rate to match what is on screen, which smooths motion and reduces tearing.

misc:mouse_move_enables_dpms.title: Wake displays on mouse movement
misc:mouse_move_enables_dpms.help: Wakes sleeping monitors when you move the mouse.

misc:key_press_enables_dpms.title: Wake displays on key press
misc:key_press_enables_dpms.help: Wakes sleeping monitors when you press a key.

misc:name_vk_after_proc.title: Name virtual keyboards after their process
misc:name_vk_after_proc.help: Names each virtual keyboard after the program that created it.

misc:always_follow_on_dnd.title: Follow drag and drop
misc:always_follow_on_dnd.help: Keeps focus following the pointer during a drag and drop. Best left on, especially when focus does not follow the mouse.

misc:layers_hog_keyboard_focus.title: Layers may hold keyboard focus
misc:layers_hog_keyboard_focus.help: Lets launchers such as wofi and bemenu keep keyboard focus when the mouse moves.

misc:animate_manual_resizes.title: Animate manual resizes
misc:animate_manual_resizes.help: Animates windows when you resize or move them by hand.

misc:animate_mouse_windowdragging.title: Animate window dragging
misc:animate_mouse_windowdragging.help: Animates a window as you drag it with the mouse. Some animation curves look odd with this on.

misc:disable_autoreload.title: Disable config auto-reload
misc:disable_autoreload.help: Stops Hyprland reloading the config when you save it, so changes apply only on a manual reload.

misc:enable_swallow.title: Window swallowing
misc:enable_swallow.help: Hides a terminal while a program it launched is running, and shows that program in its place.

misc:swallow_regex.title: Swallow window class
misc:swallow_regex.help: A regular expression matching the class of windows that get swallowed, usually your terminal.

misc:swallow_exception_regex.title: Swallow exception title
misc:swallow_exception_regex.help: A regular expression for the terminal's title. When it matches, the terminal is not swallowed, which excludes programs such as wev.

misc:focus_on_activate.title: Focus windows that request activation
misc:focus_on_activate.help: Lets an app take focus when it asks for it.

misc:mouse_move_focuses_monitor.title: Mouse movement focuses the monitor
misc:mouse_move_focuses_monitor.help: Moving the pointer onto another monitor gives that monitor focus.

misc:allow_session_lock_restore.title: Allow session lock restore
misc:allow_session_lock_restore.help: Lets you start a lockscreen app again if it crashes while the session is locked.

misc:session_lock_xray.title: Session lock X-ray
misc:session_lock_xray.help: Keeps drawing your workspaces underneath the lockscreen, so it can show them through.

misc:session_lock_blur.title: Blur under the session lock
misc:session_lock_blur.help: Blurs the lockscreen. Needs the session lock X-ray setting to be on.

misc:background_color.title: Background colour
misc:background_color.help: Colour shown behind everything when no wallpaper covers the screen. Needs the Hyprland logo hidden.

misc:close_special_on_empty.title: Close the special workspace when empty
misc:close_special_on_empty.help: Closes the special workspace when its last window goes away.

misc:on_focus_under_fullscreen.title: Focusing a window under a fullscreen one
misc:on_focus_under_fullscreen.help: What happens when something asks to focus a tiled window while another window is fullscreen or maximised.

misc:exit_window_retains_fullscreen.title: Keep fullscreen when a window exits
misc:exit_window_retains_fullscreen.help: Closing a fullscreen window makes the window that gets focus next fullscreen too.

misc:initial_workspace_tracking.title: Initial workspace tracking
misc:initial_workspace_tracking.help: Opens a window on the workspace you launched it from. 0 is off, 1 covers the app's first window, 2 also its later windows.

misc:initial_workspace_token_timeout.title: Workspace token timeout
misc:initial_workspace_token_timeout.help: How long, in seconds, a new window has to open before it stops following the workspace it was launched from.

misc:middle_click_paste.title: Middle-click paste
misc:middle_click_paste.help: Middle-clicking pastes the primary selection, which is the text you last highlighted.

misc:render_unfocused_fps.title: Unfocused render rate
misc:render_unfocused_fps.help: Caps the frame rate, in frames per second, of windows kept rendering in the background by the render_unfocused window rule.

misc:disable_xdg_env_checks.title: Skip XDG environment checks
misc:disable_xdg_env_checks.help: Hides the warning shown when the XDG environment is set up outside Hyprland.

misc:disable_hyprland_guiutils_check.title: Skip the hyprland-guiutils check
misc:disable_hyprland_guiutils_check.help: Hides the warning shown when hyprland-guiutils is not installed.

misc:disable_watchdog_warning.title: Hide the watchdog warning
misc:disable_watchdog_warning.help: Hides the warning shown when Hyprland was not started with start-hyprland.

misc:lockdead_screen_delay.title: Lock-dead screen delay
misc:lockdead_screen_delay.help: How long, in milliseconds, before the lock-dead screen appears if a lockscreen fails to cover every monitor. At most 5000.

misc:enable_anr_dialog.title: Show the “not responding” dialog
misc:enable_anr_dialog.help: Shows a dialog when an app stops responding.

misc:anr_missed_pings.title: Missed pings before “not responding”
misc:anr_missed_pings.help: How many missed checks before an app counts as not responding and the dialog appears.

misc:screencopy_force_8b.title: Force 8-bit screen capture
misc:screencopy_force_8b.help: Forces 8-bit colour in screen captures and recordings.

misc:disable_scale_notification.title: Hide the scale notification
misc:disable_scale_notification.help: Hides the popup shown when a monitor cannot use the scale you asked for.

misc:size_limits_tiled.title: Apply size limits to tiled windows
misc:size_limits_tiled.help: Applies the minimum and maximum size window rules to tiled windows, not only floating ones.

binds:pass_mouse_when_bound.title: Pass mouse events when bound
binds:pass_mouse_when_bound.help: When off, the mouse is not passed on to apps, or used to drag windows, after a keybind has fired.

binds:scroll_event_delay.title: Scroll bind delay
binds:scroll_event_delay.help: How long to wait, in milliseconds, after a scroll event before another one can trigger a scroll keybind.

binds:workspace_back_and_forth.title: Workspace back and forth
binds:workspace_back_and_forth.help: Switching to the workspace you are already on takes you back to the previous one, as in i3.

binds:hide_special_on_workspace_change.title: Hide the special workspace on switch
binds:hide_special_on_workspace_change.help: Switching workspace also hides the special workspace on that monitor.

binds:allow_workspace_cycles.title: Allow workspace cycles
binds:allow_workspace_cycles.help: Workspaces remember the one before them, so going to the previous workspace can cycle endlessly.

binds:workspace_center_on.title: Centre the cursor on workspace switch
binds:workspace_center_on.help: Where the cursor lands after a workspace switch: 0 in the centre of the workspace, 1 on its last active window.

binds:focus_preferred_method.title: Directional focus method
binds:focus_preferred_method.help: How directional focus picks a neighbour: 0 prefers recently used windows, 1 prefers the window sharing the longest edge.

binds:ignore_group_lock.title: Ignore group lock
binds:ignore_group_lock.help: Moving a window into or out of a group works even when the group is locked.

binds:movefocus_cycles_fullscreen.title: Move focus cycles fullscreen windows
binds:movefocus_cycles_fullscreen.help: On a fullscreen window, moving focus in a direction cycles to the next fullscreen window instead.

binds:movefocus_cycles_groupfirst.title: Move focus cycles the group first
binds:movefocus_cycles_groupfirst.help: On a grouped window, moving focus steps through the group's tabs first, then moves on to other windows.

binds:disable_keybind_grabbing.title: Disable keybind grabbing
binds:disable_keybind_grabbing.help: Stops apps that ask to disable your keybinds, such as virtual machines, from doing so.

binds:window_direction_monitor_fallback.title: Fall back to the monitor for directional moves
binds:window_direction_monitor_fallback.help: Moving a window or focus past a monitor's edge continues onto the next monitor in that direction.

binds:allow_pin_fullscreen.title: Allow pinning fullscreen windows
binds:allow_pin_fullscreen.help: Lets a pinned window go fullscreen and keep its pinned state afterwards.

binds:drag_threshold.title: Drag threshold
binds:drag_threshold.help: How far the mouse must move, in pixels, before a window drag or a click-or-drag keybind starts. 0 starts on mouse down.

xwayland:enabled.title: XWayland
xwayland:enabled.help: Lets apps written for X11 run under Wayland, through XWayland.

xwayland:use_nearest_neighbor.title: Nearest-neighbour scaling
xwayland:use_nearest_neighbor.help: Scales X11 apps without smoothing, so they look pixelated instead of blurry on scaled monitors.

xwayland:force_zero_scaling.title: Force zero scaling
xwayland:force_zero_scaling.help: Draws X11 apps at scale 1 on scaled monitors. They look sharp but small unless the app scales itself.

opengl:nvidia_anti_flicker.title: NVIDIA anti-flicker
opengl:nvidia_anti_flicker.help: Reduces flicker on NVIDIA cards, at the cost of possible dropped frames on weaker GPUs. Ignored on other cards.

render:direct_scanout.title: Direct scanout
render:direct_scanout.help: Sends a lone fullscreen app's frames straight to the display, which can cut lag in games. Turn it off if the app shows glitches.

render:expand_undersized_textures.title: Expand undersized textures
render:expand_undersized_textures.help: While a window is still resizing, stretches its edge to fill the gap instead of scaling the whole picture.

render:ctm_animation.title: Colour transform animation
render:ctm_animation.help: Fades between colour filter changes, such as from hyprsunset, instead of jumping.

render:cm_enabled.title: Colour management
render:cm_enabled.help: Turns Hyprland's colour management on or off.

render:send_content_type.title: Send the content type
render:send_content_type.help: Tells the monitor what kind of content is on screen so it can switch picture profile. This can cause a black screen during the switch.

render:cm_auto_hdr.title: Automatic HDR
render:cm_auto_hdr.help: Switches to HDR mode by itself when a fullscreen app shows HDR content.

render:new_render_scheduling.title: New render scheduling
render:new_render_scheduling.help: Uses triple buffering when needed, which improves the frame rate on underpowered machines.

render:non_shader_cm.title: Non-shader colour management
render:non_shader_cm.help: Applies colour management without a shader where possible. The choices set when that is allowed.

render:cm_sdr_eotf.title: SDR transfer function
render:cm_sdr_eotf.help: Which gamma curve ordinary SDR apps are shown with.

render:commit_timing_enabled.title: Commit timing
render:commit_timing_enabled.help: Supports the commit timing protocol, which lets apps schedule exactly when a frame appears.

render:icc_vcgt_enabled.title: Apply ICC VCGT tables
render:icc_vcgt_enabled.help: Sends the calibration curves of an ICC colour profile to the display hardware.

render:use_shader_blur_blend.title: Shader blur blending
render:use_shader_blur_blend.help: Experimental blending of the blurred background, glitchy on rotated screens. Turn it on if blur goes missing with FP16 buffers.

render:use_fp16.title: Use FP16 buffers
render:use_fp16.help: Draws with 16-bit floating-point internal buffers. Experimental.

render:keep_unmodified_copy.title: Keep an unmodified copy
render:keep_unmodified_copy.help: Keeps an unmodified copy of each frame for screen sharing. Turn it on if screenshots come out transparent.

render:non_shader_cm_interop.title: Non-shader colour management interop
render:non_shader_cm_interop.help: Whether colour filters from tools such as hyprsunset stay active in fullscreen.

render:fp16_sdr_tf.title: FP16 SDR transfer function
render:fp16_sdr_tf.help: Which transfer function the internal FP16 buffer uses in SDR mode.

cursor:no_hardware_cursors.title: Hardware cursors
cursor:no_hardware_cursors.help: Disabled draws the cursor with display hardware when possible, Enabled never does, and Auto skips it while tearing.

cursor:no_break_fs_vrr.title: Keep VRR in fullscreen
cursor:no_break_fs_vrr.help: Stops cursor movement from scheduling extra frames in fullscreen apps with variable refresh rate, which avoids frame rate spikes.

cursor:min_refresh_rate.title: Minimum refresh rate
cursor:min_refresh_rate.help: Lowest refresh rate, in Hz, used for cursor movement while that setting is on. Set it to your monitor's minimum or higher.

cursor:hotspot_padding.title: Hotspot padding
cursor:hotspot_padding.help: Space kept between the screen edges and the cursor's hotspot, in pixels.

cursor:inactive_timeout.title: Hide after inactivity
cursor:inactive_timeout.help: Hides the cursor after this many seconds without movement. 0 never hides it.

cursor:no_warps.title: Disable cursor warps
cursor:no_warps.help: Stops Hyprland moving the cursor by itself, for example when focus changes or a keybind runs.

cursor:persistent_warps.title: Persistent warps
cursor:persistent_warps.help: When a window regains focus, the cursor returns to where it was in that window instead of its centre.

cursor:warp_on_change_workspace.title: Warp on workspace change
cursor:warp_on_change_workspace.help: Moves the cursor to the last focused window after a workspace change. The strongest choice does so even when cursor warps are off.

cursor:warp_on_toggle_special.title: Warp on special workspace toggle
cursor:warp_on_toggle_special.help: Moves the cursor to the last focused window when you toggle a special workspace. The strongest choice does so even when cursor warps are off.

cursor:default_monitor.title: Startup monitor
cursor:default_monitor.help: Name of the monitor the cursor starts on when Hyprland launches, as listed by hyprctl monitors.

cursor:zoom_factor.title: Zoom factor
cursor:zoom_factor.help: How much the screen is magnified around the cursor, like a magnifying glass. 1 means no zoom.

cursor:zoom_rigid.title: Rigid zoom
cursor:zoom_rigid.help: Keeps the cursor centred in the zoomed view when it can, instead of letting it drift.

cursor:zoom_disable_aa.title: Disable zoom antialiasing
cursor:zoom_disable_aa.help: Shows zoomed-in content as sharp pixels instead of smoothing it.

cursor:zoom_detached_camera.title: Detached zoom camera
cursor:zoom_detached_camera.help: While zoomed in, the view moves only when the cursor reaches the screen edge, instead of following it.

cursor:hide_on_key_press.title: Hide on key press
cursor:hide_on_key_press.help: Hides the cursor while you type, until the mouse moves again.

cursor:hide_on_touch.title: Hide on touch
cursor:hide_on_touch.help: Hides the cursor after touch input, until you use the mouse again.

cursor:hide_on_tablet.title: Hide on tablet input
cursor:hide_on_tablet.help: Hides the cursor after tablet input, until you use the mouse again.

cursor:use_cpu_buffer.title: Use a CPU buffer
cursor:use_cpu_buffer.help: Makes hardware cursors use a CPU buffer, which Nvidia cards need for hardware cursors.

cursor:sync_gsettings_theme.title: Sync the cursor theme to GSettings
cursor:sync_gsettings_theme.help: Shares the cursor theme with GTK apps through GSettings, so most of them use the same cursor.

cursor:warp_back_after_non_mouse_input.title: Warp back after non-mouse input
cursor:warp_back_after_non_mouse_input.help: After a keyboard or touch action moves the cursor, returns it to where it was once you use the mouse again.

ecosystem:no_update_news.title: Hide update news
ecosystem:no_update_news.help: Hides the popup shown after Hyprland updates to a new version.

ecosystem:no_donation_nag.title: Hide the donation reminder
ecosystem:no_donation_nag.help: Hides the donation reminder popup that appears twice a year.

ecosystem:enforce_permissions.title: Enforce permissions
ecosystem:enforce_permissions.help: Turns on permission control, so apps must be allowed to use features such as screen capture.

debug:overlay.title: Debug overlay
debug:overlay.help: Draws a performance panel on screen. Turn off variable frame rate for accurate numbers.

debug:damage_blink.title: Blink on damage
debug:damage_blink.help: Flashes the screen areas that were redrawn. Warning: flashing lights.

debug:disable_logs.title: Disable logging
debug:disable_logs.help: Stops Hyprland writing its log to a file.

debug:disable_time.title: Omit timestamps from logs
debug:disable_time.help: Leaves the time out of log lines.

debug:damage_tracking.title: Damage tracking
debug:damage_tracking.help: Redraws only the parts of the screen that changed. Best left alone.

debug:enable_stdout_logs.title: Log to stdout
debug:enable_stdout_logs.help: Also prints Hyprland's log to standard output.

debug:manual_crash.title: Manual crash
debug:manual_crash.help: Setting this to 1 and then back to 0 crashes Hyprland on purpose, and you lose your session.

debug:suppress_errors.title: Suppress errors
debug:suppress_errors.help: Hides the messages Hyprland shows when it cannot read your config.

debug:disable_scale_checks.title: Disable scale checks
debug:disable_scale_checks.help: Skips checking that monitor scales fit the pixel grid, which causes rounding errors.

debug:error_limit.title: Displayed error limit
debug:error_limit.help: The most config errors the error bar lists at once.

debug:error_position.title: Error position
debug:error_position.help: Where the config error bar appears on the screen.

debug:colored_stdout_logs.title: Colour stdout logs
debug:colored_stdout_logs.help: Colours the log lines printed to standard output.

debug:log_damage.title: Log damage
debug:log_damage.help: Logs which screen areas were redrawn.

debug:ds_handle_same_buffer.title: Direct scanout of the same buffer

debug:ds_handle_same_buffer_fifo.title: Direct scanout of the same buffer (FIFO)

debug:vfr.title: Variable frame rate
debug:vfr.help: Redraws only when something changes, which saves power and processing. Leave it on unless you are debugging.

debug:invalidate_fp16.title: Invalidate FP16 buffers
debug:invalidate_fp16.help: Lets Hyprland discard FP16 buffers early, which is faster but can cause glitches on some systems.

layout:single_window_aspect_ratio.title: Single window aspect ratio
layout:single_window_aspect_ratio.help: Pads a lone window to this aspect ratio, given as width and height. On a 16:9 screen, 4 3 gives a centred 4:3 window.

layout:single_window_aspect_ratio_tolera.title: Aspect ratio tolerance
layout:single_window_aspect_ratio_tolera.help: If the padding needed is smaller than this fraction of the screen, the window is left as it is. Ranges from 0 to 1.

dwindle:force_split.title: Force split direction
dwindle:force_split.help: Decides which side of the split a new window opens on. By default it follows the mouse.

dwindle:preserve_split.title: Preserve the split direction
dwindle:preserve_split.help: Keeps each split's direction, side by side or stacked, fixed whatever happens to the windows.

dwindle:smart_split.title: Smart split
dwindle:smart_split.help: Chooses the split direction by which quarter of the window the cursor is in. This also turns on Preserve the split direction.

dwindle:smart_resizing.title: Smart resizing
dwindle:smart_resizing.help: The corner nearest the mouse moves when you drag a window's edge, instead of following its tiling position.

dwindle:permanent_direction_override.title: Permanent direction override
dwindle:permanent_direction_override.help: Keeps a preselected split direction until you pick another or turn this off, instead of using it once.

dwindle:special_scale_factor.title: Special workspace scale
dwindle:special_scale_factor.help: Scales windows on the special workspace, from 0 to 1. 1 leaves them unscaled.

dwindle:split_width_multiplier.title: Split width multiplier
dwindle:split_width_multiplier.help: Multiplies window width when choosing an automatic split. Raise it on widescreens, where windows stay wider than tall.

dwindle:use_active_for_splits.title: Split from the active window
dwindle:use_active_for_splits.help: Splits the focused window instead of the one under the mouse.

dwindle:default_split_ratio.title: Default split ratio
dwindle:default_split_ratio.help: How a new window shares space with its neighbour. 1 is an even 50/50 split; the range is 0.1 to 1.9.

dwindle:split_bias.title: Split bias
dwindle:split_bias.help: Which window of a split gets the split ratio: the top or left one, or the current one.

dwindle:precise_mouse_move.title: Precise mouse move
dwindle:precise_mouse_move.help: Drops a window you drag with a mouse bind more precisely, depending on where the pointer is.

master:special_scale_factor.title: Special workspace scale
master:special_scale_factor.help: Scales windows on the special workspace, from 0 to 1. 1 leaves them unscaled.

master:mfact.title: Master area size
master:mfact.help: How much of the screen the master area takes, from 0 to 1. At 0.7 the master takes 70 percent and the other windows 30.

master:new_status.title: New window placement
master:new_status.help: Decides the role a new window takes in the master layout.

master:new_on_top.title: New windows on top
master:new_on_top.help: Puts a newly opened window at the top of the stack instead of the bottom.

master:new_on_active.title: Place new windows relative to focus
master:new_on_active.help: Places a new window before or after the focused one. When off, New windows on top decides.

master:orientation.title: Master area position
master:orientation.help: Where the master area sits on the screen.

master:slave_count_for_center_master.title: Stack windows before centring master
master:slave_count_for_center_master.help: With a centred master, centres it only when at least this many other windows are open. 0 always centres it.

master:center_master_fallback.title: Centre master fallback
master:center_master_fallback.help: Where the master goes when there are too few other windows to centre it.

master:center_ignores_reserved.title: Centre ignores the reserved area
master:center_ignores_reserved.help: Centres the master window on the whole monitor, ignoring areas reserved by bars.

master:smart_resizing.title: Smart resizing
master:smart_resizing.help: The corner nearest the mouse moves when you drag a window's edge, instead of following its tiling position.

master:drop_at_cursor.title: Drop at the cursor
master:drop_at_cursor.help: Dropping a dragged window places it at the cursor. When off, a window dropped on the stack goes to its top or bottom.

master:always_keep_position.title: Always keep position
master:always_keep_position.help: Keeps the master window where it is configured even when there are no other windows.

master:focus_master_on_close.title: Focus master when a window closes
master:focus_master_on_close.help: Closing a window focuses the master window.

scrolling:fullscreen_on_one_column.title: Fullscreen with a single column
scrolling:fullscreen_on_one_column.help: A single column on a workspace always fills the screen.

scrolling:column_width.title: Column width
scrolling:column_width.help: Default width of a new column, as a fraction of the screen from 0.1 to 1.

scrolling:focus_fit_method.title: Focus fit method
scrolling:focus_fit_method.help: How a focused column is brought into view: centred, or moved only as far as needed to fit.

scrolling:follow_focus.title: Follow focus
scrolling:follow_focus.help: Scrolls the layout to bring a newly focused window into view.

scrolling:follow_min_visible.title: Minimum visible fraction
scrolling:follow_min_visible.help: A focused window must have at least this fraction showing for the layout to scroll to it. Clicks and keybinds always scroll.

scrolling:explicit_column_widths.title: Preset column widths
scrolling:explicit_column_widths.help: Column widths the resize keybinds cycle through, as comma-separated fractions of the screen.

scrolling:direction.title: Scroll direction
scrolling:direction.help: Which way new windows appear and the layout scrolls.

scrolling:wrap_focus.title: Wrap focus
scrolling:wrap_focus.help: Moving focus past the first or last column wraps around to the other end.

scrolling:wrap_swapcol.title: Wrap column swapping
scrolling:wrap_swapcol.help: Swapping columns past the first or last wraps around to the other end.

quirks:prefer_hdr.title: Prefer HDR
quirks:prefer_hdr.help: Tells apps that HDR is the preferred mode, always or only for gamescope.
